title: SecurityFindings
description: Normalized findings emitted by the audit stage. One file per audit focus; merged + deduped + validated downstream.

id.description: Stable within a run, e.g. AUTHZ-001

recommended_fix.description: Guidance only; pipeline does not patch.

threat_model_class.description: OPTIONAL. One of: real_bug (holds regardless of trust model) | broken_mechanism (defeats a security control the project itself ships) | by_design (intended within the stated trust model).

affected_build_config.description: OPTIONAL. The build/config the finding applies to (e.g. 'default' vs a specific hardening flag). Empty if not config-dependent.

variants.description: Where similar patterns may exist + where the author checked

live_verification_plan.description: Safe, in-scope, non-DoS steps for a human. Only for source_and_live targets.

dedup_key.description: Computed downstream: hash of normalized(file + primary_line + cwe). Not set by audit stage.

validation.description: Filled by the adversarial validation stage; absent until validated.
